# MD Nexa

> MD Nexa (مك نكسا) is an independent Android studio. It builds small, fast apps and games and publishes them on Google Play in Arabic and English. No accounts, no subscriptions.

## Products

- [MD Work](https://mdnexa9.github.io/md-work/): work notebook for Android. Tracks workdays, half-days and days off, earnings, expenses, plus daily and monthly reports, quick note, timer and checklist. Free, no account, records stored on the device. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.mdwork.notebook
- [MD Corpses](https://mdnexa9.github.io/md-corpses/): one-finger climbing game. 12 chapters, endless mode, 21 languages including Arabic. Free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mdnexa.corpses
- MD Bolt Master: colour-sorting puzzle game, in development, not released yet.
- MD Darkflow: game in development, not released yet.
